Name: Master Angler completion and Mystery of the Stardrops achievement
Author: agdanightfall
Description:
Game save for Master Angler (100% fishing) and respective Stardrop. Requires collecting 3 freshwater crab pot items to finish. Crab pots are placed on the mountain lake by the mines entrance, and ready to harvest. Once you've completed the fish collection, sleep and receive the Stardrop from Willy in the mail the next day to obtain the Mystery of the Stardrops achievement.

Unzip to ...\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Saves and load game as usual. Load "Tom" save game.  File works for Steam and Xbox Game Pass PC (shared game saves).

Note: this save will override "Tom" game save for Protector of the Valley achievement.
